label: embedding-provider — SPEC.md §1 compliance & correctness review

verification.notes: All verification passed from cache — no regressions detected.

findings.description: COMPILED_INTERFACES.md (the authoritative interface spec per CLAUDE.md) omits `maxTokens` from `EmbeddingProviderMetadata`. SPEC.md §1 (line 47) and the code in `index.ts` (line 14) both include `maxTokens: number`. The authoritative spec is stale — any implementer reading COMPILED_INTERFACES.md would produce an incomplete provider.
findings.fix_sketch: Add `maxTokens: number` to `EmbeddingProviderMetadata` in COMPILED_INTERFACES.md, matching SPEC.md §1 and the code.

findings.description: FastembedProvider (ONNX real provider) has zero test coverage. The entire ONNX path — `MODEL_CONFIGS`, worker thread lifecycle, `embedSingle`, `embedBatch` with chunk-then-mean-pool, `meanPool`, `chunkText`, `sendBatch`, `toFloat32Normalised`, worker error/exit handlers — is untested. The spec's D7 (chunk-then-mean-pool, no truncation) is not validated.
findings.fix_sketch: Add tests for: (a) MODEL_CONFIGS registration for bge-m3 and codexembed-400m, (b) chunkText produces correct boundaries, (c) meanPool normalizes correctly, (d) toFloat32Normalised handles empty/different-length arrays, (e) worker error propagation.

findings.description: FileSystemModelCache has zero test coverage despite implementing the `ModelCache` interface required by SPEC.md §1. Download, SHA-256 verification, streaming (`ensureStream`), error recovery (cleanup on failed download), and the `cached()` integrity check are all unverified.
findings.fix_sketch: Add tests for: (a) cached() detects missing files, (b) cached() detects SHA-256 mismatch, (c) ensure() throws ResolutionError on HTTP failure, (d) ensureStream() yields progress updates, (e) clear() removes directory.

findings.description: EmbeddingCache has zero test coverage despite being used by DeterministicProvider. The LRU eviction logic (maxSize boundary, get-touches-LRU, set-evicts-oldest) is unverified.
findings.fix_sketch: Add unit tests for: (a) evicts when exceeding maxSize, (b) get() promotes entry to most-recent, (c) clear() resets size to zero.

findings.description: `FastEmbedPoolConfig` is defined in `index.ts` with `maxWorkers`, `preloadModels`, and `batchSizes` fields matching SPEC.md §1, but no pool manager is implemented. `FastembedProvider` creates a single worker per instance (line 280-283) with no shared pool. The interface is dead code — callers that pass `maxWorkers` or `preloadModels` to `createEmbeddingProvider` will have them silently ignored.
findings.fix_sketch: Either remove `FastEmbedPoolConfig` from the exports if pool semantics are deferred, or implement `FastEmbedPool` as a shared worker manager that `FastembedProvider` acquires from.

findings.description: `warmUp()` in FastembedProvider has a self-contradictory comment. Line 211 says "No-op: isDeterministic is false, cache would be unreliable" but line 212 immediately says "Pre-warm the model by embedding the texts, priming ONNX inference" — then does nothing with the `texts` parameter (line 213: `void texts`). This is technically correct per the contract (warmUp is a no-op for non-deterministic providers) but the comment is actively misleading: a reader would believe the model is being warmed.
findings.fix_sketch: Remove the misleading comment on line 212 or implement actual worker pre-warming (send an init + embed batch to the worker before the first caller's request).

findings.description: DeterministicProvider hardcodes `maxTokens: 512` without accepting it as a constructor parameter. Since the deterministic provider does not actually enforce any token limit, the metadata is misleading — callers relying on `maxTokens` to govern chunking boundaries (per SPEC.md §1 D7) would incorrectly believe the hash provider enforces a 512-token limit.
findings.fix_sketch: Accept `maxTokens` as an optional constructor parameter defaulting to a reasonable value (e.g., 8192 for parity with real models), or set it to `Infinity` / `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` with a comment that the hash provider has no meaningful token limit.

findings.description: `ensureReady()` has a subtle bug: if `this.readyPromise` is null (no init in progress) and `this.ready` is false, the method resolves immediately without error — but the worker may not be initialized. `ensureReady()` is always called after `getWorker()` (which sets `readyPromise`), so in practice this path never fires. But if someone calls a method before `getWorker()`, there is no guard.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a guard in `ensureReady()` that throws if `readyPromise` is null and `ready` is false: `if (!this.readyPromise) throw new ResolutionError('Provider not initialized — call embedSingle or embedBatch first')`.

findings.description: `simulatedRemoteEmbed()` checks `text.length > 8192` as a character limit, but `maxTokens` metadata is declared as 8192 tokens (line 19). Characters ≠ tokens. This is a simulated reference implementation so it has no runtime impact, but it's inconsistent with the metadata contract.
findings.fix_sketch: Either make the check use a token estimator (matching `fastembed.ts` char/4 heuristic) or document that this is a character-based limit in the reference implementation.

findings.description: `MODEL_DIMS` and `MODEL_MAX_TOKENS` are exported with `@deprecated` JSDoc tags but are never imported anywhere in the codebase (confirmed by grep). They add dead API surface to the package exports.
findings.fix_sketch: Remove the deprecated exports. Callers should read `MODEL_CONFIGS[modelId].dim` and `MODEL_CONFIGS[modelId].maxTokens` directly.

findings.description: Worker path resolution uses `__dirname` pointing to `dist/embedWorker.js`. Verified: `dist/embedWorker.js` exists. The tsconfig includes `embedWorker.ts` in compilation (no `.spec.ts` exclusion applies), so the compiled output is correct. No BL-11 issue: ONNX runtime is only dynamically imported inside the worker thread.

Area boundary verified: all imports from `data/embed/embedding-provider/src/` import only from within the same package (`./index.js`, `./cache.js`, `./fastembed.js`, `./deterministic.js`, `./remote.js`) or Node.js stdlib. No `area:platform` imports found. `nx lint` passes. ✓
MODEL_CONFIGS correctly registers bge-m3 (line 72-78) and codexembed-400m (line 79-85) per SPEC.md §1 requirements. Both have correct dim (1024), maxTokens (8192), and hfRepoId values.

Chunk-then-mean-pool implemented per SPEC.md §1 D7 (line 578 of SPEC.md). `embedSingle()` checks `estimateTokens(text) > maxTokensVal`, splits via `chunkText()`, embeds each chunk, then `meanPool()` normalizes the result. Correct behavior: exceeding maxTokens triggers mean-pool, NOT truncation. ✓
